facts.reviewed_source_change: Exact7.2 source reviewed: prepareRequest extracted; non-metric node branch now tokenizes original node string into array preserving order. Allowed metric set and containsAll branch unchanged. Only _local and jvm,process attributed.

limitations: Only independently indexed v2 observations; historical v1 remains separate.
An HTTP 2xx observation can be an application-level refusal or a failed expectation.
Only the most specific exact source route receives a request; ties stay unassigned.
Compatibility media are separated from default media; no support is inferred.
